name: puppetloom
description: Turn a layered character PSD into a safe, autonomous 2D puppet.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @puppetloom/core && npm run build -w @puppetloom/renderer && npm run build -w @puppetloom/web-runtime && npm run build -w @puppetloom/runtime-adapters && npm run build -w @puppetloom/cli && npm run build -w @puppetloom/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @puppetloom/core && npm run build -w @puppetloom/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/core && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/web-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/runtime-adapters && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/cli && npm run typecheck -w @puppetloom/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @puppetloom/core && npm run build -w @puppetloom/renderer && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts packages
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test
scripts.test:model-agent:whole: npm run build -w @puppetloom/core && npm run build -w @puppetloom/cli && node scripts/run-whole-model-agent-e2e.mjs
